name: Shanks

idle_chatter.text: I'm the captain, dang it! Don't look down on me!
I'll take you anywhere you want to go.

routes.source_quote: Shanks at the dock sails you to Lith Harbor for 300 mesos once you reach level 7. The boat is one-way. Hand in every Maple Island quest before you board.

what_they_do: Provides transportation between towns or regions.
notes: Out of scope for Iteration Two gameplay: the boat leaves Maple Island (destination Lith Harbor, Victoria Island). Record only.
gaps: MeowDB has no structured transport data for Shanks: no boarding dialogue / Yes-No prompt text, no arrival map or spawn point, no travel time. Route facts come from the editorial beginner guide (prose), the map id from the world-map spot "Lith Harbor".
